title: Best Squarespace Alternatives: What All-in-One Leaves Out
summary: Seven Squarespace alternatives compared on the fee stack, export limits and the real year-one cost. Every price read from the vendor's own page, and dated.
body_markdown:
Judge it on the controls you get, because Squarespace is weakest here: no editable robots.txt or sitemap, no page exclusion or priority, canonical tags and advanced schema not directly controllable, redirects 301-only. Tooltester measured its mobile Google Performance score at 28.94, last among the twelve builders they tested.


Framer is architecturally strong — server-rendered React — but a custom robots.txt and an llms.txt both require Pro. Wix and Webflow give you editable robots.txt, sitemaps, redirects and structured data. Blink adds an SEO panel that scans the live site, scores it 0–100 and applies fixes in one click.
